description: One-shot file transfer with optional pricing and marketplace listing. Upload a file, set a per-download price, and list on the marketplace — all in a single call. Returns a shareable download URL. Supports free transfers, paid downloads, and marketplace listings. Provide EXACTLY ONE of: 'filePath' (local stdio — zero tokens), 'url' (remote fetch), or 'content' (base64 fallback).No API key required — without one you upload as a guest (100 MB, 24-hour link); a key raises the limits and lets you sell.

content.description: Base64-encoded file content (fallback when filePath and url are unavailable).

fileName.description: Filename with extension. Required for 'content', optional for 'url'.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local file (stdio transport only — zero token cost).

listingDescription.description: What the buyer gets (40–500 chars). Required when listingTitle is set.

listingTitle.description: Marketplace listing title (3–120 chars). When set, auto-lists the file on the marketplace once ready.

payoutAddress.description: Wallet that a priced download pays out to. Only for running without an API key — it is what lets you sell with no account. Ignored when a key is set, because that account's payout address is a dashboard setting. Payments are final: a mistyped address is unrecoverable, and an exchange deposit address usually will not credit a Base transfer from a contract.

pricePerDownload.description: Price per download in USD (e.g. 0.50). Downloaders pay in USDC. Omit or 0 for free.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the file to upload (server fetches it directly — no token cost).

name: transfer

downloadUrl.description: Shareable download URL (works without auth, valid 24h)

ready.description: True when the file is downloadable right now

status.description: Final status: READY, FAILED, or TIMEOUT

url.description: Unified page URL (includes marketplace listing context when listed)

title: Transfer File
